description: Implement navigation and structural accessibility including skip links, landmark roles, heading hierarchy, and keyboard navigation for layout components
steps: Add SkipLink component in frontend/src/components/ui/SkipLink.tsx with proper focus management and keyboard activation
Update AppLayout.tsx to include skip link, proper landmark roles (banner for header, main for content, navigation for sidebar), and heading hierarchy
Enhance Navbar.tsx with aria-label attributes, aria-current for active page, keyboard event handlers for dropdown menu (Escape, Enter, Arrow keys)
Improve Sidebar.tsx with proper navigation landmark, aria-expanded states for collapsible sections, keyboard navigation support (Tab, Escape for mobile), and aria-current for active menu items
Add ARIA live region announcements when mobile sidebar opens/closes for screen reader users
acceptance_criteria: Skip link appears on Tab press and navigates to main content
All layout sections have proper landmark roles (banner, main, navigation)
Heading hierarchy follows logical h1->h2->h3 structure
Keyboard users can navigate all navigation elements using Tab/Shift+Tab
Mobile menu can be opened/closed with keyboard and announces state changes
Active page/section is indicated with aria-current attributes
verification: npm run type-check passes without errors
Manual test: Tab through navigation, verify skip link works
Manual test: Use keyboard-only to open mobile menu, navigate items, and close
Screen reader test: Verify landmark announcements and navigation structure
findings:
Successfully implemented navigation and structural accessibility features:
- Created SkipLink component with proper focus management and keyboard activation
- Updated AppLayout.tsx with skip link, landmark roles (banner, main, navigation), and ARIA live region for mobile sidebar announcements
- Enhanced Navbar.tsx with aria-label attributes, aria-expanded states, keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Escape), and proper menu roles
- Improved Sidebar.tsx with navigation landmarks, aria-current for active pages, keyboard support for mobile menu (Escape key), and proper heading hierarchy (h1 for brand)
- Added comprehensive ARIA attributes and screen reader support throughout navigation components
- All components follow WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines for keyboard accessibility and screen reader compatibility
